Author: U. Durga Prasad Rao
Bench: U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Criminal Petition No.6060 Of 2019
Order:

1. In this Criminal Petition filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C., the petitioner/accused No.1 seeks to quash the proceedings against him in Crime No.180 of 2019 of New Port Police Station,
Visakhapatnam City, which was registered against him for the offences under Sections 270, 272,
273, 328 and 511 of IPC and Sections 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short, 'the FSS Act').
2.

entities.text:
New Port Police Station,
Visakhapatnam City
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The allegations against the petitioner briefly are that, on 26.09.2019 at 12:00 hours, on receiving the credible information, the complainant suo motu registered the case against the petitioner/Accused No.1 on the ground that he is in possession of the banned tobacco products,
having purchased the same from one Pedababu of Bada Bazar, Berhampur of Odisha, transporting the same to various shops in Gajuwaka for sale on higher prices and on interrogation as the accused voluntarily confessed to have been engaged in the business of prohibited tobacco products, seized the same, registered F.I.R., and remanded him to judicial custody for the offences stated supra.
3. Learned counsel for petitioner while denying the FIR allegations would submit that even if the prosecution case is accepted to be true, tobacco products would not fall within the definition of Section 3(j) of FSS Act and therefore the police are not authorized to register the crime, investigate and file charge sheet and therefore UDPR,J registration of the FIR is contrary to the provisions of FSS Act.
He relied upon the common order of this Court in Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.08.2018.
As can be seen, in the said common order a learned Judge of this Court partly allowed the Criminal Petitions and quashed the offences punishable under Indian Penal Code and FSS Act.

4. Following the above order and for the reasons recorded therein, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings initiated against the Petitioner/accused No.1 for the offences under Sections 270, 272, 273, 328 and 511 of IPC and Sections, 58, 59 and 63 of FSS Act are hereby quashed.
5. As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, in this case shall stand closed.

U. DURGA PRASAD RAO, J Date:01.10.2019 Dsh A.Narayana vs State Of Andhra Pradesh on 1 October, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42996354/
